between_markers: (54) 发明名称: 环磺酮的制备方法和中间体
drawings.notes: Labelled (v) at the right of the row. No reagents or conditions are written on the arrow. The four substituents sit on four consecutive ring carbons, with the two unsubstituted CH positions between Br/COOH and SO2CH3, read directly off the hexagon.

between_markers: (54) 发明名称: 环磺酮的制备方法和中间体

structures.core: benzene bearing an ester carbonyl whose oxygen carries a cyclohex-2-en-1-one ring (enol ester of cyclohexane-1,3-dione)
substituents: on the cyclohexenone ring: ester O at C1', ring double bond C1'=C2', ketone C=O at C3'
structures.name: 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl 2-chloro-4-(methylsulfonyl)-3-[(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl]benzoate

drawings.notes: Labelled (v') at the right, below the row. No reagents or conditions are written on the arrow. The cyclohexenone ring is drawn with the ester oxygen on the sp2 carbon that carries the ring double bond, and the ketone oxygen two carbons round, i.e. the 1,3 relationship of an enol ester of cyclohexane-1,3-dione.

discrepancies.what: The abstract states the method comprises any one of the following steps but names no reagents, while the two drawn arrows also carry no reagents, so nothing on this page says how either transformation is effected.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Two bare arrows, no reagents above or below either.
discrepancies.text_says: 本发明提供一种制备环磺酮的方法，其特征在于，包括如下的任意一个步骤。

discrepancies.what: Neither drawn product on the front page is cyclosulfonone itself; both are intermediates, although the title and abstract present the page as a method for preparing cyclosulfonone.
discrepancies.drawing_says: A benzoic acid (v) and its 3-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl ester (v'), each still carrying the SO2CH3 and CH2OCH2CF3 groups.
discrepancies.text_says: 环磺酮的制备方法和中间体 / METHOD FOR PREPARING CYCLOSULFONONE, AND INTERMEDIATES
